Most of us spend more time on our phones than we'd like. It isn't that we want to give up our digital lives: the flights, the bills, the replies and the plans all matter. But each one pulls us back to the screen, again and again.

Most assistants wait for you to ask. Kiwi texts you first, when something needs doing:

• "Your Saturday afternoon is free. Want me to plan something with the kids?" You say yes, pick a plan, and it books the tickets, lunch and the taxi

• "Your flight tonight is delayed an hour, so you'll land at about 1:20. Want me to book a taxi from arrivals?" One yes, and it's waiting when you land [...] Kiwi

results.title: Can an AI Actually Text You First? Proactive AI Assistants, Explained - folk
results.content:
> Quick answer: Yes, an AI can text you first. A proactive assistant reaches out for reminders you set, follow-ups it is chasing on your behalf, prices or web pages it is watching, and scheduled check-ins like a morning brief. folk does all of this inside iMessage, Telegram, and WhatsApp, and can even call your phone when a text is not enough.

## What does a proactive AI assistant mean?

Most assistants are reactive: you send a message, they reply. A proactive assistant can start the conversation on its own, based on things you asked for or conditions it is watching.

The distinction matters because the most valuable moments are the ones you would otherwise forget. You are not going to open an app to check whether a price dropped. You want the app to tell you.
